body:
I created a solution of 1mg/1ml Flualprazolam.
Flualprazolam comes on fast with a slight euphoria but settles into relaxed long lasting anxiolytic, Hypnotic. I've noticed amnesia isn't big with this one unless
I have no tolerance and go for a .75+mg dose (totally subjective). I am able to take 1.5-2mg of flualprazolam typically after work and get my house chores done and cook a nice dinner before getting some rest.
I would not recommend using this everyday as tolerance builds quickly. The euphoria will last a few hours but the main benzodiazepine effects will last well into the next day if taken in doses of .75-2mg. This one would put
me to sleep if
I wasn't used to the effects.
Since taking reasonable amounts of flualprazolam I've been building personal relationships and find social interaction to feel extremely fluid I can hit on girls again! Woohoo!
